known_gaps: Product behavior regression tests and release-contract tests are green under npm run verify, but no browser end-to-end suite exists for authenticated dashboard flows.

Production dependency audit critical gate is clear for the current locked baseline; npm audit --omit=dev still reports 5 high and 3 moderate production vulnerabilities. The remaining fixes require separate behavior-tested major-upgrade work.

Local Docker release image build, /health smoke, and restart smoke pass with placeholder Clerk environment values after re-reading Docker's dynamic host port; real cynik shadow deploy and credentialed smoke remain blocked by missing deployment credentials and target metadata.
.dockerignore reduced the Docker build context to about 689.2kB during local verification; keep generated artifacts, local evidence, and secrets out of future image contexts.

rollback.primary: Revert the pull request or redeploy the previous release artifact.
rollback.database: Only deploy backward-compatible Prisma migrations until a tested restore and rollback procedure exists.
